title: Generative Retrieval for Large-Scale Recommendation with Foundation Models
summary: This paper replaces the classic retrieve-then-rank pipeline with a generative model that directly produces item identifiers. It reports higher recall on large catalogues than dense retrieval baselines, while keeping latency practical through constrained decoding. The approach is especially relevant for foundation-model-based recommender systems.

title: LLM in RecSys: Instruction-Tuned Language Models for CTR/CVR Prediction
summary: The authors fine-tune a language model on user interaction histories and ad features to predict clicks and conversions jointly. The model improves CTR and CVR over strong gradient-boosted and deep ranking baselines in offline and online tests. It also shows how prompt design and feature verbalisation affect ad ranking quality.

title: Graph Learning for User Understanding in Advertising Targeting
summary: This work builds a heterogeneous user-ad interaction graph and learns representations that capture long-term interests and short-term intent. The learned embeddings improve audience targeting and cold-start ad performance compared with sequence-only models. The paper includes an analysis of graph size, sampling, and serving cost.
